phrase: An AI gave police a false tip about an unsolved murder, unnoticed for two months. Another AI dropped so many math results that mathematicians say checking them could take years.
phraseAlternatives: A chatbot phoned police with a false tip about an unsolved murder, and no one noticed for months. Another model flooded mathematicians with results nobody has time to check.
An AI model gave police a false lead on an unsolved murder. Nobody caught it for two months, and mathematicians are still checking another AI's flood of new results.
A false AI tip sat unquestioned in a police file for two months. A flood of AI math results may sit unchecked for years.
Police trusted an AI tip for two months before learning it was false. Mathematicians now face years of checking another AI's pile of new results.
alt: Split image divided by a vertical line. Left: a police officer stands near a small blinking unread light while a robot holds an old telephone receiver to its head, smiling. Right: a second robot's funnel pours cascading paper sheets toward a tired, half-buried mathematician who weakly holds one sheet overhead.

brief.concept: One AI gives police an unverified tip about a murder; another floods mathematicians with results nobody has time to verify.
brief.metaphor: An answer nobody double-checks: a phone tip no one hangs up on, and a paper flood no one can out-read.

cast.who: a robot speaking into an old telephone receiver at a police tip-line desk
a human police officer at a desk, looking away from a small blinking unchecked message light
a second robot tipping an endless stream of papers out of a funnel
a tired human mathematician half-buried under the growing paper pile, holding up just one sheet

brief.composition: Two side-by-side panels sharing one cream background. Left panel: a robot at a desk speaks into an old telephone; behind it, a human police officer sits under a small blinking light that stays unchecked. Right panel, mirrored: a second robot tips a funnel pouring an endless stream of papers; a tired human mathematician is half-buried in the pile, holding one sheet up to the light as if checking it. A thin vertical line divides the two scenes. No text in the image.
brief.alt: Split illustration: on the left, a robot speaks into an old telephone at a police desk while an officer's warning light blinks unchecked; on the right, a second robot pours an endless stream of papers onto a tired mathematician holding up a single sheet to check.
